pool.title: Procurement pool
pool.intro: Approved request lines nobody has ordered yet. Choose a supplier for the lines, then turn them into draft POs: lines with the same supplier, delivery site and kind (goods or service) go on one PO.
pool.forbidden: This page is for procurement. If you think you should open it, contact your organization's administrator.
pool.empty: No requests are waiting for procurement
pool.emptyHint: Approved requests come here by themselves. Meanwhile you can look at the purchase orders.
pool.noMatchHint: Change the filter, or clear it to see every line.

assign.title: Choose the supplier of the selected lines
assign.nothing: No line selected yet. Tick the lines you want first.
assign.submit: Use this supplier for the selected lines
assign.clear: Remove the supplier from the selected lines
assign.cleared: Supplier removed from {count} lines. They wait in the pool until a supplier is chosen again.
assign.urgent: Urgent requests got {count} draft POs at once, without waiting for the round
assign.blocked: {count} of the ticked lines come from requests whose prices include VAT, so they wait in the pool and are not put on a draft PO yet
assign.needLines: Tick the lines you want first
assign.urgentConfirm: The lines you ticked include {count} urgent requests. Choosing {supplier} drafts their POs at once, and a draft cannot be thrown away or given another supplier yet.
assign.urgentConfirmButton: Confirm: use this supplier and draft now

round.title: Make draft POs
round.cronInvalid: No automatic round runs: the round time in the organization's settings cannot be read. Contact your organization's administrator.
round.none: No automatic round in the next 8 days. You can make drafts yourself at any time.
round.hint: Only lines with a supplier are put on POs; lines without one wait in the pool. Urgent requests get their draft PO as soon as their supplier is chosen. Requests whose prices include VAT are not put on draft POs yet, urgent or not. A draft can have its prices and quantities changed and lines taken off, but it cannot be thrown away or given another supplier yet.
round.madeNone: No line was ready this round. Choose a supplier for the lines first, then try again.
round.madeNoneBlocked: No line was ready this round.
round.left: {count} lines stay in the pool because they have no supplier yet
round.leftNone: No line is left in the pool
round.leftBlocked: {count} lines stay in the pool because their requests' prices include VAT: they cannot go on a draft PO until a decision is made on how such prices become purchase order prices
round.blockedInPool: {count} lines in the pool come from requests whose prices include VAT, so they are not put on draft POs until a decision is made on how such prices become purchase order prices
round.leftWaiting: {count} lines got a supplier while the round ran and go in the next round
round.confirmText: Put the {count} lines that have a supplier on draft POs now. A draft cannot be thrown away or given another supplier yet: check the suppliers of the lines in the pool first.

rounds.title: Earlier rounds
rounds.label: Earlier consolidation rounds
rounds.empty: No round has run yet. When you make drafts or an automatic round runs, it shows here.

errors.LINE_NOT_IN_POOL: Some lines are no longer in the pool; they may be on a draft PO already. Reload the page to see the latest list.
errors.SUPPLIER_INACTIVE: This supplier is inactive. Choose another supplier.
errors.SUPPLIER: This supplier was not found. Choose a supplier from the list.
errors.NO_CHANGE: The selected lines already have this supplier; nothing changed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only procurement chooses suppliers and makes draft POs.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Some lines were not found. Reload the page to see the latest list.
errors.BUSY: Someone is working on these requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different data. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try once more.
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved because of a system error (reference {requestId}). Try again, or tell your administrator this reference.
errors.FAILED: Not saved. Try again, or contact your administrator.

blocked.PRICE_INCLUDES_VAT: Prices include VAT: this request cannot go on a draft PO yet, until a decision is made on how prices that include VAT become purchase order prices
